csv_project_name: Continuing Engineering Services for Minor Projects
csv_scope_of_work: Continuing Contracts for Engineering Services in the following categories: 1. MEP/FP Engineers 2. Civil/Geotechnical Engineers 3. Structural. Typical projects assigned under this contract may include new construction, renovation, remodeling, studies, reroofing, other building maintenance, equipment installation, pre- engineered metal buildings, greenhouses, pole barns, asbestos abatement, recreation and fire code corrections. Areas requiring renovation or remodeling may include all types of spaces common to an institution of higher education and teaching zoo. Utilities Projects may include modeling and design of gravity and pressure piping and pumping systems distribution and collection, high-voltage electrical distribution, and central utility plant chilled water and hot water modeling and design.
